resources.string: Reading new messages aloud. Listens only right after a message.
Reads other apps aloud when you ask LUNEYRA.

When you ask, LUNEYRA reads aloud the text shown by the app in front, and can go back or to the home screen. It does not watch your activity in the background, does not read password fields, and cannot tap, type or send anything. You can turn it off here or inside LUNEYRA at any time.
